enumdef.name: lv_obj_flag
enumdef.help: Flags that control the object's behavior

enum.name: hidden
enum.help: Make the object hidden. (Like it wasn't there at all)

enum.name: clickable
enum.help: Make the object clickable by the input devices

enum.name: click_focusable
enum.help: Add focused state to the object when clicked

enum.name: checkable
enum.help: Toggle checked state when the object is clicked

enum.name: scrollable
enum.help: Make the object scrollable

enum.name: scroll_elastic
enum.help: Allow scrolling inside but with slower speed

enum.name: scroll_momentum
enum.help: Make the object scroll further when 'thrown'

enum.name: scroll_one
enum.help: Allow scrolling only one snappable children

enum.name: scroll_chain_hor
enum.help: Allow propagating the horizontal scroll to a parent

enum.name: scroll_chain_ver
enum.help: Allow propagating the vertical scroll to a parent

enum.name: scroll_chain
enum.help: SCROLL_CHAIN_HOR and SCROLL_CHAIN_VER

enum.name: scroll_on_focus
enum.help: Automatically scroll object to make it visible when focused

enum.name: scroll_with_arrow
enum.help: Allow scrolling the focused object with arrow keys

enum.name: snappable
enum.help: If scroll snap is enabled on the parent it can snap to this object

enum.name: press_lock
enum.help: Keep the object pressed even if the press slid from the object

enum.name: event_bubble
enum.help: Propagate the events to the parent too

enum.name: gesture_bubble
enum.help: Propagate the gestures to the parent

enum.name: adv_hittest
enum.help: Allow performing more accurate hit (click) test. E.g. consider rounded corners.

enum.name: ignore_layout
enum.help: Make the object not positioned by the layouts

enum.name: floating
enum.help: Do not scroll the object when the parent scrolls and ignore layout

enum.name: send_draw_task_events
enum.help: Send `LV_EVENT_DRAW_TASK_ADDED` events

enum.name: overflow_visible
enum.help: Do not clip the children to the parent's ext draw size

enum.name: event_trickle
enum.help: Send events to children first

enum.name: state_trickle
enum.help: Propagate state changes to children

enum.name: flex_in_new_track
enum.help: Start a new flex track on this item

enum.name: layout_1
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by layouts

enum.name: layout_2
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by layouts

enum.name: widget_1
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by widget

enum.name: widget_2
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by widget

enum.name: user_1
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by user

enum.name: user_2
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by user

enum.name: user_3
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by user

enum.name: user_4
enum.help: Custom flag, free to use by user

element.name: style
element.help: Add a style to the widget

arg.name: selector
arg.help: Target part and state, can be ORed, e.g. pressed|knob

element.name: remove_style_all

element.name: bind_style

element.name: screen_load_event

element.name: subject_increment_event

arg.name: step

element.name: bind_state_if_ge

arg.name: ref_value
arg.help: Reference value to compare the subject against

element.name: bind_state_if_lt

prop.name: name
prop.help: Object name (for lv_obj_find_by_name or debugging)

prop.name: x
prop.help: Set X position (px or %)

prop.name: y
prop.help: Set Y position (px or %)

prop.name: height
prop.help: Set height (px, % or content)

prop.name: width
prop.help: Set width (px, % or content)

prop.name: align
prop.help: Align on parent

prop.name: ext_click_area
prop.help: Extra clickable area around object in px

prop.name: scroll_snap_x
prop.help: Snap children horizontally

prop.name: scroll_snap_y
prop.help: Snap children vertically

prop.name: scrollbar_mode
prop.help: Set the scrollbar mode

prop.name: style_x-selector
prop.help: Horizontal position relative to the parent's content area (px or %). Usually set `align` or use a layout instead.

prop.name: style_y-selector
prop.help: Vertical position relative to the parent's content area (px or %). Usually set `align` or use a layout instead.

prop.name: style_height-selector
prop.help: Widget height: px, % of the parent, or `content` to shrink-wrap the children.

prop.name: style_min_height-selector
prop.help: Minimum height the widget may shrink to (px or %). Useful with `content` sizing.

prop.name: style_max_height-selector
prop.help: Maximum height the widget may grow to (px or %). Useful with `content` sizing.

prop.name: style_width-selector
prop.help: Widget width: px, % of the parent, or `content` to shrink-wrap the children.

prop.name: style_min_width-selector
prop.help: Minimum width the widget may shrink to (px or %). Useful with `content` sizing.

prop.name: style_max_width-selector
prop.help: Maximum width the widget may grow to (px or %). Useful with `content` sizing.

prop.name: style_length-selector
prop.help: Size of a widget-specific element (e.g. scale tick length, arc/slider knob). Meaning depends on the widget.

prop.name: style_pad_top-selector
prop.help: Space between the top edge and the content/children (px).

prop.name: style_pad_bottom-selector
prop.help: Space between the bottom edge and the content/children (px).

prop.name: style_pad_left-selector
prop.help: Space between the left edge and the content/children (px).

prop.name: style_pad_right-selector
prop.help: Space between the right edge and the content/children (px).

prop.name: style_pad_hor-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for `pad_left` and `pad_right` together (px).

prop.name: style_pad_ver-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for `pad_top` and `pad_bottom` together (px).

prop.name: style_pad_all-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for all four paddings at once (px).

prop.name: style_pad_row-selector
prop.help: Gap between rows of children in a flex/grid layout (px).

prop.name: style_pad_column-selector
prop.help: Gap between columns of children in a flex/grid layout (px).

prop.name: style_pad_gap-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for both `pad_row` and `pad_column` (px).

prop.name: style_pad_radial-selector
prop.help: On round scales, distance of the tick labels from the scale (px).

prop.name: style_margin_top-selector
prop.help: Empty space kept above the widget in a layout, pushing neighbors away (px).

prop.name: style_margin_bottom-selector
prop.help: Empty space kept below the widget in a layout, pushing neighbors away (px).

prop.name: style_margin_left-selector
prop.help: Empty space kept left of the widget in a layout, pushing neighbors away (px).

prop.name: style_margin_right-selector
prop.help: Empty space kept right of the widget in a layout, pushing neighbors away (px).

prop.name: style_margin_hor-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for `margin_left` and `margin_right` (px).

prop.name: style_margin_ver-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for `margin_top` and `margin_bottom` (px).

prop.name: style_margin_all-selector
prop.help: Shorthand for all four margins at once (px).

prop.name: style_radius-selector
prop.help: Corner radius (px). 0 = square corners. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_radial_offset-selector
prop.help: Shifts the part radially out from (or into) the center on round widgets such as scales (px). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_align-selector
prop.help: Anchor point of the widget within the parent (e.g. center, top_left). `x`/`y` then act as offsets from it.

prop.name: style_clip_corner-selector
prop.help: Clip the content/children to the rounded corners set by `radius`. Small performance cost. Default: false.

prop.name: style_base_dir-selector
prop.help: Base text direction (LTR/RTL/auto). Affects bidirectional text order and which side the vertical scrollbar sits on.

prop.name: style_bg_color-selector
prop.help: Background fill color. Only visible when `bg_opa` is above 0.

prop.name: style_bg_opa-selector
prop.help: Background opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 0 (transparent) — raise it to reveal `bg_color`/gradient.

prop.name: style_bg_grad_dir-selector
prop.help: Background gradient direction: none, hor or ver. Blends `bg_color` into `bg_grad_color`. Default: none.

prop.name: style_bg_main_stop-selector
prop.help: Position where the start color stops fading, 0-255 (0=start, 128=middle, 255=end). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_bg_grad_stop-selector
prop.help: Position where the end color begins, 0-255. Default: 255.

prop.name: style_bg_grad_color-selector
prop.help: Second color of the background gradient (used when `bg_grad_dir` is set).

prop.name: style_bg_main_opa-selector
prop.help: Opacity of the gradient's start color (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_bg_grad_opa-selector
prop.help: Opacity of the gradient's end color (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_bg_image_src-selector
prop.help: Background image (image name or symbol). Drawn over the background color and under the border.

prop.name: style_bg_image_opa-selector
prop.help: Background image opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_bg_image_tiled-selector
prop.help: Repeat (tile) the background image to fill the area instead of drawing it once. Default: false.

prop.name: style_bg_image_recolor-selector
prop.help: Color blended onto the background image; intensity set by `bg_image_recolor_opa`.

prop.name: style_bg_image_recolor_opa-selector
prop.help: Strength of `bg_image_recolor` (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 0 (no recolor).

prop.name: style_border_color-selector
prop.help: Border color. Only visible when `border_width` is above 0.

prop.name: style_border_width-selector
prop.help: Border thickness (px). Drawn inside the bounds, so it doesn't change the widget's size. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_border_opa-selector
prop.help: Border opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_border_side-selector
prop.help: Which edges get a border: none/left/right/top/bottom/full (can be ORed). Default: full.

prop.name: style_border_post-selector
prop.help: Draw the border after the children so it stays on top of them. Default: false.

prop.name: style_outline_color-selector
prop.help: Outline color. Only visible when `outline_width` is above 0.

prop.name: style_outline_width-selector
prop.help: Outline thickness (px). Drawn outside the bounds and doesn't affect layout. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_outline_opa-selector
prop.help: Outline opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_outline_pad-selector
prop.help: Gap between the widget's edge and the outline (px); can be negative.

prop.name: style_shadow_width-selector
prop.help: Shadow blur size (px). Default: 0 (no shadow). Larger spreads a softer shadow.

prop.name: style_shadow_color-selector
prop.help: Shadow color. Only visible when `shadow_width` is above 0.

prop.name: style_shadow_opa-selector
prop.help: Shadow opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_shadow_offset_x-selector
prop.help: Horizontal shadow offset (px), positive = right. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_shadow_offset_y-selector
prop.help: Vertical shadow offset (px), positive = down. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_shadow_spread-selector
prop.help: Grow (or shrink, if negative) the shadow by this many px before blurring. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_text_color-selector
prop.help: Text color.

prop.name: style_text_opa-selector
prop.help: Text opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_text_font-selector
prop.help: Font used for the text.

prop.name: style_text_align-selector
prop.help: Horizontal text alignment: left/center/right/auto (auto follows the base direction).

prop.name: style_text_letter_space-selector
prop.help: Extra spacing between characters (px); can be negative.

prop.name: style_text_line_space-selector
prop.help: Extra spacing between lines (px); can be negative.

prop.name: style_text_decor-selector
prop.help: Text decoration: none, underline or strikethrough.

prop.name: style_text_outline_stroke_color-selector
prop.help: Color of the outline drawn around the glyphs. Only visible when `text_outline_stroke_width` is above 0.

prop.name: style_text_outline_stroke_width-selector
prop.help: Thickness of the outline drawn around the glyphs (px). Default: 0 (no outline).

prop.name: style_text_outline_stroke_opa-selector
prop.help: Opacity of the glyph outline (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_image_opa-selector
prop.help: Opacity of images the widget draws (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_image_recolor-selector
prop.help: Color blended onto the image; intensity set by `image_recolor_opa`.

prop.name: style_image_recolor_opa-selector
prop.help: Strength of `image_recolor` (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 0 (no recolor).

prop.name: style_line_width-selector
prop.help: Line thickness (px). Default: 0 (nothing drawn).

prop.name: style_line_color-selector
prop.help: Line color.

prop.name: style_line_opa-selector
prop.help: Line opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_line_dash_width-selector
prop.help: Length of each dash (px). 0 = solid line.

prop.name: style_line_dash_gap-selector
prop.help: Gap between dashes (px). Needs `line_dash_width` above 0.

prop.name: style_line_rounded-selector
prop.help: Round the line (and dash) endpoints. Default: false.

prop.name: style_arc_width-selector
prop.help: Arc thickness (px). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_arc_color-selector
prop.help: Arc color.

prop.name: style_arc_opa-selector
prop.help: Arc opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_arc_rounded-selector
prop.help: Round the arc endpoints. Default: false.

prop.name: style_arc_image_src-selector
prop.help: Image drawn along the arc instead of a solid color (e.g. a gradient/textured arc).

prop.name: style_layout-selector
prop.help: Layout engine that positions the children: none, flex or grid.

prop.name: style_flex_flow-selector
prop.help: How children flow in a flex layout: row/column, optionally wrapping/reversed. Needs `layout`=flex.

prop.name: style_flex_main_place-selector
prop.help: Distribution of children along the main axis (e.g. start, center, space_between). Default is `start`.

prop.name: style_flex_cross_place-selector
prop.help: Alignment of children on the cross axis (perpendicular to the flow). Default is `start`.

prop.name: style_flex_track_place-selector
prop.help: Alignment of the track(s). Default is `start`.

prop.name: style_flex_grow-selector
prop.help: Share of leftover track space this child claims relative to its siblings. 0 = don't grow.

prop.name: style_grid_column_dsc_array-selector
prop.help: Array of column track sizes, e.g. `20 1fr content`. Needs `layout`=grid.

prop.name: style_grid_row_dsc_array-selector
prop.help: Array of row track sizes, e.g. `20 1fr content`. Needs `layout`=grid.

prop.name: style_grid_column_align-selector
prop.help: How to distribute the columns when the grid has spare horizontal space.

prop.name: style_grid_row_align-selector
prop.help: How to distribute the rows when the grid has spare vertical space.

prop.name: style_grid_cell_column_pos-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: the column index where its cell starts (0-based).

prop.name: style_grid_cell_column_span-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: how many columns its cell spans.

prop.name: style_grid_cell_x_align-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: horizontal alignment within its grid cell.

prop.name: style_grid_cell_row_pos-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: the row index where its cell starts (0-based).

prop.name: style_grid_cell_row_span-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: how many rows its cell spans.

prop.name: style_grid_cell_y_align-selector
prop.help: On a grid child: vertical alignment within its grid cell.

prop.name: style_opa-selector
prop.help: Opacity of the whole widget and its children (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 255 (opaque).

prop.name: style_opa_layered-selector
prop.help: Like `opa`, but composites the widget as one layer so overlapping parts don't show through. Slower. Default: 255.

prop.name: style_anim_duration-selector
prop.help: Length of the widget's built-in animation in ms (e.g. label scroll). Default: 0. Exact effect is widget-specific.

prop.name: style_blend_mode-selector
prop.help: How the widget's pixels mix with the background: normal, additive, subtractive, multiply or difference.

prop.name: style_transform_width-selector
prop.help: Enlarge (or shrink, if negative) the drawn widget horizontally without affecting layout (px).

prop.name: style_transform_height-selector
prop.help: Enlarge (or shrink, if negative) the drawn widget vertically without affecting layout (px).

prop.name: style_translate_x-selector
prop.help: Shift the widget horizontally after layout (px or %); siblings are not affected.

prop.name: style_translate_y-selector
prop.help: Shift the widget vertically after layout (px or %); siblings are not affected.

prop.name: style_translate_radial-selector
prop.help: On round/scale layouts, move the widget toward or away from the parent's center (px).

prop.name: style_transform_scale_x-selector
prop.help: Horizontal zoom: 256 = 100%, 128 = 50%, 512 = 200%. Default: 256 (no scaling).

prop.name: style_transform_scale_y-selector
prop.help: Vertical zoom: 256 = 100%, 128 = 50%, 512 = 200%. Default: 256 (no scaling).

prop.name: style_transform_rotation-selector
prop.help: Rotation in 0.1° units (450 = 45°, 3600 = 360°). Default: 0. Pivot set by `transform_pivot_x`/`y`.

prop.name: style_transform_pivot_x-selector
prop.help: X of the rotation/scale pivot, relative to the widget's top-left corner (px or %). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_transform_pivot_y-selector
prop.help: Y of the rotation/scale pivot, relative to the widget's top-left corner (px or %). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_transform_skew_x-selector
prop.help: Horizontal skew in 0.1° units. Not supported by the SW renderer. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_transform_skew_y-selector
prop.help: Vertical skew in 0.1° units. Not supported by the SW renderer. Default: 0.

prop.name: style_bitmap_mask_src-selector
prop.help: An A8/L8 image used as an alpha mask: the widget is drawn on a layer and masked by this bitmap.

prop.name: style_rotary_sensitivity-selector
prop.help: Scales rotary-encoder/Crown input in 1/256 units: 256 = 1:1, 128 = half, 512 = double. Default: 256.

prop.name: style_recolor-selector
prop.help: Color blended over the whole widget and its children; intensity set by `recolor_opa`.

prop.name: style_recolor_opa-selector
prop.help: Strength of `recolor` (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 0 (no recolor).

prop.name: style_blur_radius-selector
prop.help: Gaussian blur radius applied to the widget (px). Default: 0 (no blur). Has a performance cost.

prop.name: style_blur_quality-selector
prop.help: Blur rendering trade-off: prefer speed or precision.

prop.name: style_blur_backdrop-selector
prop.help: true: blur what is behind the widget (frosted-glass effect); false: blur the widget itself. Default: false.

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_radius-selector
prop.help: Blur radius of the drop shadow (px). Default: 0 (no drop shadow).

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_offset_x-selector
prop.help: Horizontal drop-shadow offset (px). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_offset_y-selector
prop.help: Vertical drop-shadow offset (px). Default: 0.

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_color-selector
prop.help: Drop-shadow color.

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_opa-selector
prop.help: Drop-shadow opacity (0-255 or 0-100%). Default: 0 (invisible), raise it to show the shadow.

prop.name: style_drop_shadow_quality-selector
prop.help: Drop-shadow rendering trade-off: prefer speed or precision.

prop.name: flex_grow
prop.help: Set flex grow to fill the available space in the track

prop.name: flex_flow
prop.help: Set flex flow direction (row, column, etc.)

prop.name: checked
prop.help: Mark widget as checked (e.g. switch or checkbox)

prop.name: focused
prop.help: Mark widget as focused

prop.name: focus_key
prop.help: Mark widget as focused via key navigation

prop.name: edited
prop.help: Mark widget as being edited (e.g. text input)

prop.name: hovered
prop.help: Mark widget as hovered by a pointer

prop.name: pressed
prop.help: Mark widget as pressed

prop.name: scrolled
prop.help: Mark widget as being scrolled

prop.name: disabled
prop.help: Disable widget interaction

prop.name: hidden
prop.help: Make the object hidden. (Like it wasn't there at all)

prop.name: clickable
prop.help: Make the object clickable by the input devices

prop.name: click_focusable
prop.help: Add focused state to the object when clicked

prop.name: checkable
prop.help: Toggle checked state when the object is clicked

prop.name: scrollable
prop.help: Make the object scrollable

prop.name: scroll_elastic
prop.help: Allow scrolling inside but with slower speed

prop.name: scroll_momentum
prop.help: Make the object scroll further when 'thrown'

prop.name: scroll_one
prop.help: Allow scrolling only one snappable children

prop.name: scroll_chain_hor
prop.help: Allow propagating the horizontal scroll to a parent

prop.name: scroll_chain_ver
prop.help: Allow propagating the vertical scroll to a parent

prop.name: scroll_chain
prop.help: SCROLL_CHAIN_HOR and SCROLL_CHAIN_VER

prop.name: scroll_on_focus
prop.help: Automatically scroll object to make it visible when focused

prop.name: scroll_with_arrow
prop.help: Allow scrolling the focused object with arrow keys

prop.name: snappable
prop.help: If scroll snap is enabled on the parent it can snap to this object

prop.name: press_lock
prop.help: Keep the object pressed even if the press slid from the object

prop.name: event_bubble
prop.help: Propagate the events to the parent too

prop.name: event_trickle
prop.help: Send events to children first

prop.name: state_trickle
prop.help: Propagate state changes to children

prop.name: gesture_bubble
prop.help: Propagate the gestures to the parent

prop.name: adv_hittest
prop.help: Allow performing more accurate hit (click) test. E.g. consider rounded corners.

prop.name: ignore_layout
prop.help: Make the object not positioned by the layouts

prop.name: floating
prop.help: Do not scroll the object when the parent scrolls and ignore layout

prop.name: send_draw_task_events
prop.help: Send `LV_EVENT_DRAW_TASK_ADDED` events

prop.name: overflow_visible
prop.help: Do not clip the children to the parent's ext draw size

prop.name: radio_button
prop.help: Allow only one radio_button sibling to be checked
